app.name: Bluetooth proxy
app.summary: Home Assistant reaches Bluetooth devices near the screen. Costs Wi-Fi: slower screen, choppy video.
app.setting_proxy_hint: Off gives the radio to Wi-Fi alone, for smoother pictures and camera streams. No build needed.
app.part_c6_hint: Adds an Install button in Home Assistant for the firmware of the Wi-Fi chip. Bluetooth needs a recent one. Nothing installs until you press it.
